module sequence_detector(
     input  clk, 
     input  rst_n,
     input  data_in, 
     output sequence_detected				
     );
     reg [1:0] state;
     reg sequence_detected;
     always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
         if (!rst_n) begin
             state <= 2'b00;
         end
         else begin
             case (state)
                 2'b00: begin
                     if (data_in) begin
                         state <= 2'b01;
                     end
                     else begin
                         state <= 2'b00;
                     end
                 end
                 2'b01: begin
                     if (data_in) begin
                         state <= 2'b10;
                     end
                     else begin
                         state <= 2'b00;
                     end
                 end
                 2'b10: begin
                     if (data_in) begin
                         state <= 2'b11;
                         sequence_detected <= 1'b1;
                     end
                     else begin
                         state <= 2'b00;
                     end
                 end
                 2'b11: begin
                     if (data_in) begin
                         state <= 2'b11;
                     end
                     else begin
                         state <= 2'b00;
                     end
                 end
             endcase
         end
     end
     assign sequence_detected = sequence_detected;
endmodule
